environment.note: Development services and other user workloads may be active. No CPU affinity or host isolation.

method.aggregation: Median of three per-run means/percentiles/GC statistics; not a pooled percentile
method.timing: Uninstrumented source, official nengi-buffers writer, counting transport, controlled clock; step excludes application mutation and spatial-index updates
method.gc: Node PerformanceObserver GC events during the measured mutation/index/step loop; excludes forced warmup GC and result summarization
method.memory: Heap difference before construction vs after warmup, both after explicit GC; retained memory, not cumulative allocation
method.order: Fresh sequential processes, alternating variant order; first 18 cases repeated three times, then two crossing controls repeated three times
method.metrics: Disabled except the two explicitly named metrics controls
method.limits: Not isolated from other host workloads; small timing changes are uncertain. No sockets, clients, renderer or Jigsaw game loop in timed runs. GC count alone is not an allocation estimate.

source.description: Captured working source includes earlier pending Next RC changes in both variants. Only this allocation/visibility pass differs.

probes.settings: 100 roots, eight users, two setup ticks and one measured tick; fresh empty-result identities counted after observing warmup results
probes.countBoundary: Source-level plan factories, spatial merges, batch descriptors and observed object identities; not cumulative allocated bytes
probes.validation: All 26 cases decode the expected population and emit byte-identical packets before/after and instrumented/uninstrumented. All 20 timed workloads retain identical bytes per tick and send counts.
